description: Canonical PSR smoke-test for sensor validation gate. Independent of PosterDemo: flat 'none' terrain, two crossing targets at 10-50 km, no weather. Exercises PSR build-classify-detect-track end-to-end. Uses sband_PSR (60nm, S-band 2.8 GHz — canonical ASR-11 spec per physics_validation_audit.md). Expected: real posRMS numbers, Tracked% > 80%, blue rotating-radar ring + green/red beam cone in 3D view, Primary sensors: 1 | Beacon sensors: 0.
